description: Java class implementing a rule node for forwarding messages to another rule chain within the Thingsboard rule engine. It handles initialization, message processing, and configuration upgrades.

classes.name: TbRuleChainInputNode
classes.description: A rule node class that forwards messages to a specified rule chain, with optional dynamic resolution based on message originator.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration, parsing rule chain ID and setting forwarding behavior.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Processes incoming messages, forwarding them to the target rule chain, with cycle detection.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Handles configuration upgrades from older versions.

methods.name: getOriginatorDefaultRuleChainId
methods.description: Retrieves the default rule chain ID based on message originator type.
